wire: Reuses mixed-delivery-v1, mixed-delivery-terminal-v1 and existing authenticated witness RPC. No new ACK field or public proof that recipient runs this configuration.
scope: Conditional LOCAL mixed recipient rollback fencing and exact recovery; requires trusted recipient/signing service and linearizable authenticated nonrollback receiver authority.

bootstrap.namespace: Explicit trusted 128-bit receiver namespace, distinct from sender deployment namespace; not selected by incoming request. Namespace, route/profile and key check bound in witnessed metadata.
bootstrap.create: Fresh store plus explicit admin bootstrap; an existing namespace cannot be reinitialized. Normal open refuses missing store and never bootstraps.
bootstrap.restore: Explicit restore_new into a fresh trusted schema or in-place exact-state recovery; no migration from old count/mixed inbox profiles.
bootstrap.keys: Separate trusted receiver storage vault, witness signing pin and mTLS client authority roles. Reference same-file authority rejected. Production independent fault domains not established.

state.image: Existing agent-ledger-image-v1 whole-state encoding; all recipient schema/rows except local witness_anchor
state.private: Accepted result envelopes and terminal controls remain encrypted; witness does not hold vault master key
invariants: Combined route sequence exactly contiguous and unique
Record IDs/sequence and signed descriptors agree
Accepted event inside original lifetime; closed event after expiry; all events <= preserved clock floor
Exact trusted schema, expected route/profile/key/namespace metadata

transaction.begin: BEGIN IMMEDIATE then authenticate receiver witness head and check exact local image before time/business state
transaction.commit: Witness CAS accepts complete next image before local anchor/local commit; only then sign ordinary or terminal ACK
transaction.reject: Business rejection preserves witnessed monotonic clock floor; authority failure prevents receipt, never falls back
transaction.unknown_outcome: Witness acceptance with lost reply/local process death is authoritative; stale copy must recover, never treat local rollback as unaccepted/unclosed
transaction.clones: Same-head competing clones have at most one CAS winner; loser recovers authoritative event before signing

checks: unchanged authority head before local recovery commit
recovery.effects: One SQLite transaction; no result transmission, new acceptance, new closure, new sample or budget modification. Restored original ciphertext and first event times.
recovery.roles: Restorer may fetch/restore but cannot commit live inbox transitions; observer cannot retrieve full image

retention.policy: Retain ALL accepted envelopes and CLOSED records in the authoritative image; no prune/GC/reset API.
retention.rationale: Deleting only receiver records could revive prior delivery IDs or sequence slots and erase original first-event evidence.
retention.capacity: Hard full-image limit; an over-limit transition rolls back locally without ACK and retains prior authoritative records. Lowered-threshold test covers limit path; not a throughput/capacity benchmark.
retention.pending: Separate v2 sender/recipient implement logical prefix GC, loopback authenticated delivery and conservative current-image byte admission; see retention_recipient_contract.json and retention_capacity_contract.json. Existing v1 retains ALL records. Archive availability, scalable history, interop and production proof remain.

verification.full_pipeline: Mixed signed/encrypted/witnessed sender, expired histogram closure then count delivery, independent receiver namespace/file/service; all synthetic and loopback on same host.
verification.negative_control: Rolling back both receiver store and receiver authority still allows repeated first acceptance, 100 -> 110; production nonrollback is not proved.

remaining: Production receiver/witness nonrollback, independent fault domains and cross-host disaster recovery
Cryptographic evidence to an external verifier of receiver witness state/configuration, if required; current ACK trusts recipient service
Existing v1 remains retain-all. V2 logical GC and conservative byte admission are separate; scalable journal, aggregate resource limits and key lifecycle remain.
Pre-L3 withheld/cancel and cross-route public observation protocol
Independent interoperability, complete security/observation proof, full P2/strong-baseline evaluation and broader P3-P6 work
